item.tib: dug mtsho khol ma'i rgyud las 'jigs byed gtor zlog chen po srid zhi'i tsakra'i lce dbal
item.coloph: dus snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis me 'brug zla 8tshes 26gyi nam gung du gyim shod shel brag tshal gyi shar phyogs seng chen 'gying ba'i g.yu ral rtse nas rgya rim pa bdun bsal nas zab mo'i gter du spyan drangs shing slar lo dus kyi bka' rgya yol nas phyi pa sde gsum rkyen gyis bskyal ba la brten te sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs brtan du dmigs te brda don 'phrod pa gtan la dbab pa dge legs 'phel rgyas su gyur cig/
